purchaseOrders.panelNone: The buyer has not issued a purchase order for this order yet.
purchaseOrders.title: Purchase order {number}
purchaseOrders.paymentTermsValue: {days, plural, =0 {On delivery} one {# day after the buyer accepts the goods} other {# days after the buyer accepts the goods}}
purchaseOrders.msmeYou: You declared your business as a {category} enterprise with an Udyam number. The buyer must pay you within the legal limit: at most 45 days from accepting the goods when you accept this purchase order, or 15 days without a written agreement.
purchaseOrders.msmeNot: Declare your business as a micro or small enterprise in Company settings so that buyers are reminded of the legal payment limit.

ackForm.title: Your answer
ackForm.hint: Accepting is your written agreement to these terms, including the payment terms. If you reject it, say why; the buyer can then send a new version.

invoiceForm.title: Record your invoice
invoiceForm.hint: Enter your own GST tax invoice for this purchase order. The platform does not issue invoices and does not send anything to the GST portal.
invoiceForm.numberHint: Up to 16 characters: letters, digits, hyphen, slash.
invoiceForm.file: Invoice copy (PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB, optional)
invoiceForm.einvoiceHint: If your invoice has an IRN, copy the values from the e-invoice portal. We check the formats only.
invoiceForm.signedQrHint: The long text inside the QR code of the e-invoice.

invoices.title: Your invoices
invoices.none: You have not recorded an invoice yet.
invoices.daysLeft: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
invoices.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}
invoices.dueFromInvoice: Counted from the invoice date, {date}, until the buyer confirms delivery.
invoices.agreementWritten: Written agreement: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} allowed.
invoices.agreementNone: No written agreement (the purchase order was not accepted): 15 days.

check.consistent: The QR matches the invoice details.
check.mismatch: The QR does not match the invoice details. Check what you entered.
check.unchecked: Not checked against the e-invoice portal.

invoices.voidHint: Only possible before the buyer records a payment.

msme.title: MSME status
msme.intro: Micro and small enterprises with an Udyam number are protected by section 15 of the MSMED Act and section 43B(h) of the Income Tax Act: buyers must pay within 45 days of accepting the goods (15 days without a written agreement) or lose the tax deduction for that year.
msme.declaration: I confirm my business is a micro or small enterprise that makes goods or provides services (not a pure trader), and I will keep my Udyam number up to date.
msme.udyamOn: An Udyam number is on file.
msme.udyamOff: No Udyam number on file. Add it in Verification; without it the payment limit is not applied.
msme.covered: Payment-limit tracking is on for your invoices.
msme.notCovered: Payment-limit tracking is off for your invoices.
msme.confirmRequired: Tick the confirmation to declare your enterprise as micro or small.
